title: Propulsion
description: A Paper/Spigot plugin that turns fireworks fired from crossbows into movement boosts.
body:
## Features

- Launch yourself using crossbow fireworks
- Stronger fireworks = stronger boost
- Reduced self-damage
- Only affects the shooter
- Requires close explosion range
- Disabled in water/lava
- Max height: 150 blocks


```
firework-max-height: 150.0

weapon-disable-duration-seconds: 20

# Disabling means that once you launch with the fireworks during that weapon disable time the mace or spear wont do work.
disable-mace:
  enabled: true

disable-spear:
  enabled: true
```
